trend: AMA introduction: founder answers questions on ingredients, doses and building a supplement brand in India
why: An AMA lets people ask the hard questions. Answering them openly is the transparency story told live.
rules: r/AMA allows personal AMAs. Don't put a store link in the post. Block 2 to 3 hours to answer comments as they come in. Don't give medical advice; point people to a doctor.
title: I spent 10+ years in corporate fighting 3 PM crashes and bad sleep, then built a supplement brand that publishes a lab report for every ingredient. AMA
text:
Hi Reddit. I'm Abhishek, I live in India, and three weeks ago I launched SILT Nutrition, two drink mixes for busy people. One is for the morning (steady energy, gut, daily vitamins) and one is for the night (sleep and recovery).

You can ask me why we settled on 80 mg caffeine with 200 mg L-theanine for the morning, why SILT Nights has no melatonin, or what a lab report (COA) actually tells you and what it leaves out. I'm also happy to talk about what it takes to launch a supplement brand in India, from FSSAI labelling to finding a manufacturer, and about what I got wrong in the first three weeks.

What I won't do is give medical advice. SILT isn't meant to treat insomnia, deficiencies or any condition, and if that's what you're dealing with, a doctor is the right person.

I'll be here for the next few hours answering everything, including the skeptical questions.
